## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear description of the problem or idea. Ex. "I wish Castle had [...]"

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. For a new enemy or
power-up, describe its behavior and how it fits the difficulty curve.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've thought about.

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
